items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: if I had to choose the most authentic New Orleans style trumpet player right now, it would be Sharky... I knew Sharky couldn't play Louis Range... But anyway, you hear a lot of talking about Sharky.
